name: LG OTR Microwave HV Transformer Primary
purpose: LMHM2237BD §10 — HV transformer primary winding 0.2–0.5 Ω (Rx1) with leads removed.
failureModes: Open (OL): transformer primary failed — no heat
testingTips: Disconnect power, discharge HV capacitor, remove primary leads before measuring
Primary and filament windings to ground must read infinite (Rx1000)

name: LG OTR Microwave HV Transformer Secondary
purpose: LMHM2237BD §10 — HV transformer secondary 50–120 Ω (flowchart) / 65–120 Ω (component table).
failureModes: Open (OL): no HV output to magnetron
Out of range: replace HV transformer
testingTips: Measure secondary with leads removed; discharge capacitor first
Filament winding reads ~0 Ω — do not confuse with secondary

name: LG OTR Microwave High-Voltage Fuse
purpose: LMHM2237BD §10 — HV fuse continuity; normal under 10 Ω.
failureModes: Open (OL): blown HV fuse — inspect door switches, magnetron, HV diode/cap before replace
testingTips: Disconnect power and discharge HV capacitor before fuse access
Blown HV fuse often follows monitor-switch fault or HV short

name: LG OTR Microwave Noise Filter Coil
purpose: LMHM2237BD §6-4 dead-unit flow — noise filter L(1)–L(2) and N(1)–N(2) coils less than 1 Ω.
failureModes: Open coil: unit dead / no display
0 Ω across resistor network: shorted filter
testingTips: Remove leads before measuring coil pairs
L(1)–L(2) or N(1)–N(2) resistor path should read ~1.5 MΩ (not coil pairs)

name: LG OTR Microwave Turntable Motor
failureModes: Several ohms or infinite: replace motor
testingTips: Disconnect motor leads; measure at motor terminals
If motor OK but no rotation, check door latch and RY1 relay on PCB
